snippet.title: Fields of Gold // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095920/Fields_of_Gold/

Fields of Gold is a casual farming game where you grow crops, expand your fields, and build manufactories. Defend your farm from mischievous rabbits as you transform your land into a thriving agricultural empire. Start playing now and defend your farm before the rabbits take over!

Developed by
Thierry Braun and Tarek Wilkening
